description: Shared Tier-1 secret / Tier-2 PII fixture corpus. Canonical source of truth for cross-surface sanitizer parity (SANITIZATION_EPIC.md Task 5.2). Every entry MUST be redacted by all three sanitizers: Codex (plugins/skillmeter/scripts/sanitizer.js), Claude (skillmeter/scripts/lib/sanitize.js), and the session collector (src/skillbench/sanitizer.py). A Tier-1 miss is a failing test that blocks merge in the respective repo. Copies of this file are vendored into each repo's test fixtures and MUST stay byte-identical; bump `version` when the set changes and update all copies together.
notes: All secrets are fake, non-functional fixtures.

Values are expressed as `parts` joined with the empty string; a part matching /^HI[0-9]+$/ expands to `hi` truncated to that length. This keeps high-entropy fillers deterministic and identical across languages, and keeps full secret-looking literals (slack, PEM headers) out of source so repo secret-scanning / detect-private-key does not flag the fixture file itself.
tier1 = secret (fail-closed, blocks merge). tier2 = PII (email).
